content.short: Vela Exchange focuses on bridging centralized and decentralized exchanges for traders.
content.description: Vela Exchange sits among the leading DeFi trading protocols, backed by substantial investment from Jade Protocol. It enables perpetual swapping and provides up to 30x leverage on its supported tokens. A defining feature is its seamless blend of centralized and decentralized exchange elements within a single platform, giving users on the decentralized side access to orders such as buy orders and stop-loss. This combination aims to offer familiar trading capabilities with the security and openness of DeFi.
